notes.title: v0.25
notes.notes:
- Action info in combat for more fluent playing flow.
- Show inner power on the combat unit.
- Combat values change effect.
- Removed inner power upper limit because the complexity it brings is greater than its contribution to playing experience.
- New damage type: armor only. Can only damage armor.
- New spell condition: armor greater or equal to
- Seamless transaction of slides
- Fix background bug.
- Show price in a transaction.
- Update hit sound effect

notes.title: v0.24
notes.notes:
-地区人物卡片变为上方中置，使对话操作更加连贯
-多目标技能改为并发，加快战斗节奏

notes.title: v0.23
notes.notes:
- Ally system, now you can add ally leader in the combat act element. The ally leader and their followers will join the player's team in the combat but they are controlled by ai.

- Add new spell target types: All, AllExcludeSelf, selfTeamExcludeSelf

- damage number fade out

- Remove build-in gain health/armor effect. Given the player more freedom to customize. You can use the image spell effect to add your effects.

notes.title: v0.22
notes.notes:
-Spell system rework, target selection is moved to spell unit. AOE attack will make effects on all targets selected in the spell unit. Please fix spells and passives in old scripts

-Combat position adjust to make use of more screen space

-new act element: change map image

-fade in and fade out effect in the map switching

notes.title: V0.21
notes.notes:

 -add/remove effect image on combat characters
 -add/remove combat background
